role: set of atoms of a finite Borel measure nu on the real line
notes: Countable by thm:p15-w02b-p15-002-atomic-split. For a probability law mu it equals the discontinuity set A of its distribution function.

role: purely atomic part of a finite Borel measure
notes: nu_d is nu restricted to A_nu; nu_c is nu restricted to the complement. Subscript d marks the atomic (Durrett: discrete) part.

role: atomless remainder of a finite Borel measure
notes: nu_d is nu restricted to A_nu; nu_c is nu restricted to the complement. Subscript d marks the atomic (Durrett: discrete) part.

role: purely atomic part of a Borel probability law
notes: Unique by item 2 of thm:p15-w02b-p15-002-three-part. Distinct from the regular and singular parts nu_r, nu_s of thm:p15-lebesgue-decomposition (two-part split for a general base measure) and from the Jordan components alpha^+, alpha^- of thm:p15-jordan-decomposition.

role: absolutely continuous part of a Borel probability law relative to Lebesgue measure
notes: Unique by item 2 of thm:p15-w02b-p15-002-three-part. Distinct from the regular and singular parts nu_r, nu_s of thm:p15-lebesgue-decomposition (two-part split for a general base measure) and from the Jordan components alpha^+, alpha^- of thm:p15-jordan-decomposition.

role: continuous singular part of a Borel probability law relative to Lebesgue measure
notes: Unique by item 2 of thm:p15-w02b-p15-002-three-part. Distinct from the regular and singular parts nu_r, nu_s of thm:p15-lebesgue-decomposition (two-part split for a general base measure) and from the Jordan components alpha^+, alpha^- of thm:p15-jordan-decomposition.

role: distribution function of the purely atomic part of a real law
notes: Feller's atomic component F_a (Feller II, sec. V.2, eq. (2.4)) is F_d divided by p_d; Feller's F_s, F_ac in eq. (3.9) are normalized two-part components, not these unnormalized functions.

role: distribution function of the absolutely continuous part of a real law
notes: Feller's atomic component F_a (Feller II, sec. V.2, eq. (2.4)) is F_d divided by p_d; Feller's F_s, F_ac in eq. (3.9) are normalized two-part components, not these unnormalized functions.

role: distribution function of the continuous singular part of a real law
notes: Feller's atomic component F_a (Feller II, sec. V.2, eq. (2.4)) is F_d divided by p_d; Feller's F_s, F_ac in eq. (3.9) are normalized two-part components, not these unnormalized functions.

role: total mass of the purely atomic part of a real law
notes: Nonnegative, sum one. p_d is Feller's total atomic weight p (sec. V.2).

role: total mass of the absolutely continuous part of a real law
notes: Nonnegative, sum one. p_d is Feller's total atomic weight p (sec. V.2).

role: total mass of the continuous singular part of a real law
notes: Nonnegative, sum one. p_d is Feller's total atomic weight p (sec. V.2).

role: example Borel probability law (1/4) delta_2 + (1/2) lambda on (0,1) + (1/4) Cantor law
notes: Local to the worked example and def:p15-w02b-p15-002-reading. Unrelated to the registered substitution rho (P2-P12) and other rho entries in symbols.csv.
